title: FBI-UAP-D039, Digital Rendering 2, “Multiple Red Lights,” 2026
doc_notes: This document consists of three pages of digital renderings depicting a UAP sighting from November 28, 2024, including technical metadata such as altitude and distance to target.

incidents.summary: Observation of a bright white circular object with concentric halos over a mountain range at night.
incidents.quote: bright, featureless white disc centered in the upper half, surrounded by three faint, concentric glowing halos
